plan.name: Lay out reader statecharts by reachability
plan.summary: Lay out checked chart states in left-to-right columns by their shortest visible-arrow distance from any initial state, with deterministic ordering within columns that reduces crossings and gives a forward chain no crossings. Size each state from its own displayed text, independently of incident arrows and other states' labels, and route forward, same-layer, back, parallel and self-loop arrows distinctly with each literal label on its own route and clear of states and other labels. Arrange the complete readable report compactly beside or below the drawing, use singular and plural count wording correctly, and retain every bound, rule, qualification, occurrence, count, provenance and temporal trace fact. Preserve #608's API, pinned tests, topology and SVG inspection hooks, inert metadata, literal text, accessibility, deterministic read-only rendering, validation and supported capacity without external resources or rendering tools. Update SPEC.md and docs/statecharts.md to describe the delivered layout with the existing D-0347, D-0343, D-0122 and D-0294 grounds; the merger records the layout choice as a follow-up decision because the plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestSVG613ReachabilityLayouts
tests.says: The #608 fixtures, a chain, diamond, back cycle, loops, parallel arrows, multiple initials and hidden shortcut have deterministic shortest-distance columns, distinct attached routes, labels on their routes, and no overlapping states or arrow labels; the chain has no crossings and capacity remains 500 states and 999 arrows.

tests.name: TestSVG613OrdersLayersToReduceCrossings
tests.says: An interleaved pair of branches is ordered consistently across adjacent columns so its independent forward arrows do not cross.

tests.name: TestSVG613StateBoxesFollowTheirOwnText
tests.says: Adding incident arrows does not enlarge state boxes; a longer state label enlarges its own box without enlarging another state's box.

tests.name: TestSVG613CompactCompleteReport
tests.says: The four-state #608 report retains all visible evidence and exact metadata, uses readable nonoverlapping text, and fits within 4800 by 2400 SVG units beside or below the drawing.

tests.name: TestSVG613CountGrammar
tests.says: State captions say 1 concrete state and 2 concrete states, and generated singular occurrence counts in the drawing and report do not use plural nouns.
